title: fix(objectql)!: a nested write's stale-roll-up refusal never answers for a delete or transaction that did not land
body:
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92cLDdfrzbfFte3TG7C44xC)_ Fixes #29291 Clause-②: no (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: none Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` or the hand-written docs teaches what a cascade delete or a rolled-back transaction answers when a dependent's roll-up cannot be recomputed; the two generated reference pages only list the code Narrowing note: a delete or a transaction that answered success after rolling back now refuses (`!` in the title, full dogfood, seat contract review); claim amendment 6577647622 on #29291. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：级联删除里，某个子记录的汇总重算失败（`ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`，意思是"这次写入已落库，只是汇总没算出来"）不再原样冒给父记录删除的调用方；事务因这个错误回滚时也一样。两处都改成一个不带错误码的内部错误（数据入口答 500），原错误挂在 `cause` 上。 - 为什么改：数据入口、MCP、动作/沙箱/流程都把这个错误码当作"写入成功"。原子级联里子记录一失败整个事务回滚，父记录和子记录都还在，可调用方被告知删除成功（主干实测：`DELETE` 答 `200 { success: true }`，记录仍在）。 - 风险与回滚：只在"嵌套写入的汇总失败、外层写入没落地"时改答复；子记录自己的删除、事务里自己捕获后提交、加入外层事务的写入照旧答 `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`。无新错误码、无数据迁移，回滚即整体 revert。 - 先看：`packages/objectql/src/summary-errors.ts`（新增 `unlandedWriteRefusal` 及两个包装）；`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`（`runByIdDelete` / `runPredicateDelete` 的级联调用，以及 `ObjectQL.transaction` 与 `ScopedContext.transaction` 的回滚 catch）。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-cascade-summary-rollback.test.ts`，应看到 7 个测试全部通过；动作入口另见 `packages/runtime/src/action-delete-cascade-summary-rollback.test.ts`（2 个，动作体内 `ctx.engine.delete` 答 400 拒绝而非成功）。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes `SummaryRecomputeError` (`ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`) means "this write is stored, only a parent roll-up recompute failed", and every answering surface turns it into the write's own success. Two engine units carried a nested write's refusal past the point where it stopped being true. Both now convert it at the engine, so no answering surface changes: - **The cascade walk** (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, the `cascadeDeleteRelations` call in `runByIdDelete` and in `runPredicateDelete`). A dependent's refusal stops the walk before the parent's own row is removed, so it is never the parent delete's answer. It becomes `cascadeStoppedRefusal(e, object)`. This covers every plan: the atomic plan (the owning transaction then rolls back), a joined transaction, the `'split'` plan and a runtime that cannot roll back. - **An owned transaction that rolls back** (`ObjectQL.transaction` and `ScopedContext.transaction`, the catch after the rollback). A refusal escaping the callback is no longer true once every write in it is undone. It becomes `rolledBackRefusal(e)`. - **One meaning, one place** (`packages/objectql/src/summary-errors.ts`). `unlandedWriteRefusal` is the single conversion: a code-less `Error` (an unrecomputable roll-up is an internal failure, so the data doors answer `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`). Its message names the unit that did not complete and the stale summary (`PARENT.FIELD`), and the original refusal is kept as `cause`. Every other error passes through unchanged. It matches by `code`, as every other reader of the refusal does. Nothing new is exported, and there is no new error code or member. - **Unchanged, by design:** the refusal anywhere it is still true. That covers a dependent's own delete, a write outside any unit, a transaction that catches it and commits (the `inAfterAbortUnit` commit-then-rethrow included), and a joined transaction, whose owner decides. - **No source change outside the engine.** PR #29283 (merged as `153869d7`) made the action, sandbox and flow writers answer a landed write's refusal as success; they read the engine's answer, so the conversion reaches them with no edit there. - **Changeset:** `.changeset/29291-cascade-summary-refusal-rolled-back.md`, `@objectstack/objectql` patch, BREAKING (narrowing), `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. ## Why Measured on `origin/main` `a19759ac` before the fix, with `engine-cascade-summary-rollback.test.ts` (a stub driver that really rolls back; a two-level `master_detail` cascade where each line's delete recomputes a roll-up on another parent, and that parent's update is refused): | case | stored after | caller was told | |---|---|---| | atomic plan, delete the account | account and both lines (rolled back, 1 begin / 1 rollback) | `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`, `written: true` (the line's result) | | runtime that cannot roll back | account and line 2; **line 1 deleted** | `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`, `written: true` | | caller's own `transaction()` around a line delete | both lines (rolled back) | `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`, `written: true` | At the REST door on a real `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3), `DELETE /api/v1/data/qcr_account/a1` answered `200 {"object":"qcr_account","id":"a1","success":true}` while the account and all three lines were still stored. **The non-atomic plan, as the delta asked.** On a runtime that cannot roll back, the dependent the walk reached first stays deleted (its own write landed) and the parent and every later dependent stay stored. The parent's own write did not land, so the ruling's first sentence covers it without any reading of my own: the parent's caller now gets the same refusal. The message says that dependents written before the stop stay written unless a transaction rolls them back. What lands is unchanged. Whether the walk should instead tolerate a dependent's stale summary and finish the delete is a widening the ruling does not cover; see Acceptance notes. ## Tests Three new files, red first (no existing test was edited; no forced test edits): - `packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-summary-rollback.test.ts` (7). Refusal pins assert `code` undefined and `cause.code === 'ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE'`, plus what is stored: - atomic plan by id: refused, 1 rollback, account and lines stored; - a runtime that cannot roll back, by id: refused, account stored, line 1 gone (the measured reading); - the same by predicate (`multi: true`): refused, account stored; - a caller's engine `transaction()` the refusal rolls back: refused, nothing stored; - the same through a scoped context's `transaction()` (`ctx.api`); - CONTROL the line's own delete: `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`, `written: true`, line gone; - CONTROL a caller's transaction that catches the refusal and commits: the refusal stays, 0 rollbacks, line gone. - Red on base: 3 of the first 5 (the predicate and scoped-context cases were added after the fix; each is shown red by its own ablation below). - `packages/rest/src/data-delete-cascade-summary-rollback.test.ts` (2). The composed REST harness of `data-write-summary-recompute-refused.test.ts` on a real `SqlDriver`: `DELETE` of the account answers `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` with the account and all lines stored; CONTROL `DELETE` of a line answers `200 { success: true }` and the line is gone. Red on base (objectql `dist` proven to be main's): 1 of 2, `expected 200 to be 500`. - `packages/runtime/src/action-delete-cascade-summary-rollback.test.ts` (2), added after PR #29283 merged. The real stack of `dispatcher-unique-violation-wire-code.test.ts` (`HttpDispatcher` → `POST /api/v1/actions/:object/:action` → `ctx.engine` → `ObjectQL` → `SqlDriver` on better-sqlite3), same cascade shape: an action whose body runs `ctx.engine.delete('qca_account', 'a1')` answers the action door's `400` refusal (`success: false`, the engine's message), the body's next line never runs, and the account and all three lines are still stored. CONTROL an action deleting a line itself answers `200` with its body's result and the line is gone. Red with the conversion ablated (AB0-action below): `expected 200 to be 400`, body `{"success":true,"data":{"deleted":"a1"}}`, the bug as reported. The door answers `400` because it answers every throw out of an action body that way (a hook's or body's own `throw` is a deliberate 4xx); this PR changes nothing there.
Ablations: each mutation landed with ablation-replace, red, restored to blob == HEAD | # | mutation | file | red | |---|---|---|---| | AB0 | `unlandedWriteRefusal` passes every error through (built; `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in 4 dist files; restored, rebuilt, `--absent` and tree clean) | `summary-errors.ts` | engine 5 of 7 (every refusal pin, both controls green); REST 1 of 2 | | AB0-action | the same mutation, on `2af3815d` (built; marker present in 4 dist files; restored, rebuilt, `--absent` and tree clean) | `summary-errors.ts` | action pin 1 of 2 (`expected 200 to be 400`); CONTROL green; green again after restore | | AB1 | by-id walk without `cascadeStoppedRefusal` | `engine.ts` | 1 of 7 (no-rollback by id; the atomic case stays green through the transaction conversion) | | AB2 | predicate walk without it | `engine.ts` | 1 of 7 (predicate) | | AB3 | `ObjectQL.transaction` rollback without `rolledBackRefusal` | `engine.ts` | 1 of 7 (caller's transaction) | | AB4 | `ScopedContext.transaction` rollback without it | `engine.ts` | 1 of 7 (scoped context) | AB1 to AB4 ran on `a5bc9c90` plus the predicate pin (committed as the next commit), and AB0 on that commit. The first AB0 attempt used a comment marker, which tsup strips, so the dist preflight could not see it (the red reading was the same). It was rerun with a string-literal marker, and the counts above are from that rerun.
## Acceptance notes - **Declared as narrowing** (the declaration line above; claim amendment 6577647622). A delete whose cascade a dependent's failing roll-up stopped, and a transaction that refusal rolled back, answered success (`ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`, read as success by every door) and now answer `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` at the data door and `400` at the action door. The published `@objectstack/objectql` behaves differently on that answer; the data that lands is unchanged. - **The 500 body is the door's sanitised `{"error":"Internal server error","code":"INTERNAL_ERROR"}`.** The message (what did not complete, which summary is stale, the fix) reaches the server log and `cause`. It names the object in double quotes on purpose: a single-quoted object name beside a "not" is read by the data door's unknown-object heuristic (`data-error-classification.ts`) as `404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`. The first green leg measured exactly that (`404 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`), and the quotes were changed before the pin was finalised. - **Out of reach on purpose:** the discrete `beginTransaction` / `commit` / `rollback` trio on `ScopedContext` (the QuickJS sandbox's `ctx.api.transaction`). The caller drives the rollback there, so the engine never sees the refusal leave the unit. Since PR #29283 (merged as `153869d7`), a sandbox body's write already answers its own success inside such a unit. Also unchanged is the degrade path of `transaction()` on a runtime that cannot roll back, where every write before the refusing one, and the refusing one itself, did land. - **Noted, not filed (read-only inference, not measured):** an `after*` hook whose `ctx.api` write raises the refusal. The outer write's abort unit (`inAfterAbortUnit`) catches it, commits and rethrows, so both writes did land and the code is true. The `written` the caller reads, though, is the hook write's result, not the outer write's. - **The non-atomic alternative left open:** tolerating a dependent's stale summary, so that the walk continues and the parent delete lands with `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`, would turn refused deletes into landed ones (widening). The ruling does not cover it, so it is not done here; see `open_questions` in the card report. - **PR #29283 (#28861) merged as `153869d7`** while this PR was open. `main` is merged in (`8fc7f886`) and the one pin through an action surface the seat asked for is added (the runtime file above). - No `packages/spec/**`, `ui/**`, governed or workflow file. ## Verification
Suites and typecheck - `@objectstack/objectql` full local suite on `f1eec6fd` (main merged at `504ba510`): 529 of 529 files, 10266 of 10266 tests; `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. `os-verify-lock` VERDICT command-exit 0 for the whole chain. - `@objectstack/rest` full local suite on `f1eec6fd`: 368 of 368 files, 6976 passed and 332 skipped; `typecheck`: exit 0. - Final head `2af3815d` (main merged at `8fc7f886`, then the action pin): the three new files re-run green (objectql 7 of 7, rest 2 of 2, runtime 2 of 2), and `@objectstack/runtime` `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` + `check:test-typecheck`) exit 0. The objectql and rest full suites above are not re-run: since `f1eec6fd` this branch changed only test files and the changeset, and main's own changes are covered by the dogfood below. - **Full dogfood on the final head `2af3815d`** (rerun, because merging main changed code): closure built (`turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...'`, 68 of 68), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 (34m19s, shared box), Test Files 393 passed and 3 skipped (396), Tests 3243 passed and 28 skipped (3271). The earlier run on `f1eec6fd` was also green (391 files, 3223 tests).

Each ran with `< /dev/null`. `--ran` reconciles **63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN** (exit 0), and all 63 exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (prerequisite: some package dists missing) and is recorded from its re-run after `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'` (78 of 78, all cache hits): exit 0.
